requirement: Implement ImbalancedClassificationEvaluator class that computes balanced evaluation metrics (balanced accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and ROC-AUC), enforces binary label validation, ensures minority class sample quotas, and suppresses misleading raw accuracy when class imbalance exceeds a safety threshold.
skeleton: ImbalancedClassificationEvaluator class with threshold_probabilities and evaluate methods returning metric dictionaries.

rationale.teaches: Imbalance-aware evaluation: binary label validation, a minority quota, a probability threshold that maps to the positive class, balanced accuracy as the primary metric, and raw accuracy withheld above the imbalance threshold.
rationale.why: On a 95:5 dataset a constant classifier scores 95 percent raw accuracy. The fixture builds that dataset so the evaluator's choice of metric decides pass or fail.

candidates.why_wrong: pos_label defaults to 0, so precision, recall, and F1 are computed for the majority class.
Non-binary labels are accepted, so a three-class input produces meaningless binary metrics.
The minority quota uses <=, so exactly min_minority samples is rejected.
The threshold branch is inverted, so probabilities below the threshold become the positive class.
Raw accuracy is reported as the primary metric and balanced accuracy is omitted, so the imbalanced dataset looks excellent.
